description: A procurement notice's core value is an innovative urban-rail energy-storage pilot.

candidates.title: Metro procures a pilot wayside energy-storage system
candidates.search_snippet: The metro issued a procurement for a pilot wayside energy-storage system to recover braking energy.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic pilot procurement notice. The metro issued a procurement for a pilot wayside energy-storage system that captures regenerative braking energy. The notice describes the storage chemistry, the wayside test site, trial objectives, measurement plan, and procurement action.

contract_notes: Procurement discovery intent does not determine the formal category.
The factual core is a new method and pilot, so the category is 技術新知 with subtype procurement.
Being below USD 3M is not an eligibility gate.
